xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5287: Workflow redesign S: frame seams (changes contracts, openBeside/openDock, dock store, root helper, needs-you and agents selectors, keyboard registry)

plan.title: Workflow redesign S: frame seams (changes contracts, openBeside/openDock, dock store, root helper, needs-you and agents selectors, keyboard registry)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: This is child S of the PAN-5284 epic, already split from the epic by the operator's order book: the seam bundle every later child builds on. Its 19 items are small, mostly independent vertical slices (each owns its own files and tests) that fan out in parallel after two foundations (contracts, registry core); the file count comes from one test file per seam plus the existing handlers the registry must absorb, not from one large change. Splitting it further into sibling issues would force children A, B and E to wait on several merges instead of one.

narratives.Problem: The workflow redesign (PAN-5284) has eight UI and API children that all need the same shared pieces: the conversation-changes types, a way to open a file beside the chat and to open the dock, a dock store, a mapping from a conversation to an explorer root, one Needs-you selector and one Agents-working selector that every count surface agrees on, and one keyboard registry. Today eight places count Needs-you differently, app shortcuts live in five separate listeners, and Stage tab shortcuts use keys Chrome never delivers on Linux.
narratives.Proposal: Land the seams first, with no UI change except the D-7 key bindings and a ? sheet: plain TypeScript contracts in @overdeck/contracts; openBeside/openDock on StageDeckContext implemented in Stage/index.tsx; a zustand workDockStore persisted per deck; rootIdForConversation/rootLabelFor/useRootLabel; pure buildNeedsYouItems/buildAgentsWorking builders with thin hooks over existing react-query keys; a shortcut registry with a window capture listener for global keys and a window bubble listener for not-editing keys (so terminals and Home type-to-focus keep their keys), then migrate App, Stage, Sidebar, emergency stop, explorer and a new N binding onto it; a seed script for the shared workflow UAT fixture; docs and changelog.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Any dock, left-column, top-bar, conversation-header or project-Home UI (children B, D1, E, F, G)
- Switching any existing count surface (top bar, Home page, project Home, conversation list) to the new selectors
- Replacing rootLabel() call sites or ExplorerPane's header label
- Binding global Ctrl+Shift+E, Ctrl+Shift+G, Ctrl+Shift+F or Ctrl+P (child B binds them with the dock)
- Any server code or the /changes API (child A)
- Migrating page-local or modal-local key handling: Escape-to-close, Kanban/Pipeline j/k, composer voice shortcut, useTypeToFocus, MessagesTimeline Ctrl+F, God View keys, the open-favorite-editor shortcut in lib/keybindings.ts
- Seeding the operator's live dashboard (~/.overdeck) with the fixture
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row

autoDecisions.summary: Contracts are plain TypeScript interfaces copied from parent §6.1 (S-D1).
autoDecisions.rationale: The parent PRD shows interfaces and calls S 'types only'; child A can add schemas if its route needs decoding.

autoDecisions.summary: openDock writes workDockStore only; no key or button calls it in S (S-D2).
autoDecisions.rationale: The dock UI arrives in child B; binding Ctrl+Shift+E/G now would persist open:true with nothing rendered.

autoDecisions.summary: Add useRootLabel but keep rootLabel() and its ExplorerPane call sites (S-D3).
autoDecisions.rationale: AC-S requires no visible change and explorer-rpc.test.ts pins rootLabel; child B switches the label when it moves the explorer into the dock.

autoDecisions.summary: The registry installs a window capture listener for global keys and a window bubble listener for not-editing keys, instead of one capture listener (S-D5).
autoDecisions.rationale: A pure capture listener would take keys from xterm (Ctrl+K/J/W reach the shell today because xterm cancels them) and from Home's useTypeToFocus, whose test pins that g and / go to the composer; two phases keep today's behavior while letting global keys beat Monaco as D-7 requires.

autoDecisions.summary: S binds only the D-7 keys whose actions exist today; Files/Changes/Search/global Go-to-file are left to child B (S-D6).
autoDecisions.rationale: Those actions need the dock; registering them early would swallow keys with no visible result.

autoDecisions.summary: N is registered in CommandDeck/index.tsx next to handleNewConversation (S-D7).
autoDecisions.rationale: D-7 maps N to today's quick create, which exists only there; the edit is at most 12 lines under the 1612 cap, and child F moves it with the button. The Command Deck mounts only on its own route, so N does nothing elsewhere.

autoDecisions.summary: The ? sheet entry yields while God View is active (S-D8).
autoDecisions.rationale: GodViewConfluence uses ? for its own help and skips defaultPrevented events, so a global ? would break it.

autoDecisions.summary: Stage tab ⌘N chips render only on macOS (S-D9).
autoDecisions.rationale: After D-7 the ⌘N chip is wrong on Linux/Windows and a 'Ctrl Alt 1' chip on every tab would crowd the bar; child D2 removes the chips anyway.

autoDecisions.summary: Explorer quick open/content search follow the platform modifier only (S-D10); predicates stay exported.
autoDecisions.rationale: D-7 defines Ctrl+P / ⌘P; the pinned predicate tests stay green.

autoDecisions.summary: Migrating Sidebar.tsx, ExplorerPane.tsx/useExplorerShortcuts.ts and CommandDeck/index.tsx in S despite the parent §8 ownership table.
autoDecisions.rationale: §8 forbids edits only while the owner's PR is open; S is every child's prerequisite and the Flywheel holds their planning until S merges, so no owner PR can be open. Edits are limited to handler removal plus registration.

autoDecisions.summary: The fixture script refuses OVERDECK_HOME equal to the operator's ~/.overdeck and writes transcripts under --home (default $HOME) (S-D11).
autoDecisions.rationale: resolveSessionFile finds Claude transcripts only under os.homedir(); the fixture repo path is unique, so its encoded transcript directory is new and never touches an existing transcript.

autoDecisions.summary: NeedsYouItem carries optional subject and decision payloads (S-D12).
autoDecisions.rationale: Child E's menu needs answer controls; carrying the source avoids re-deriving it.

autoDecisions.summary: The changelog file is changelog.d/pan-5287.md, not 5287.md as the child stub said.
autoDecisions.rationale: changelog.d/README.md requires the lowercase issue id with prefix and lint:docs checks it.

autoDecisions.summary: Add a user page features/keyboard-shortcuts.mdx and fix the Ctrl/Cmd wording in features/file-explorer.mdx.
autoDecisions.rationale: Tab switching changes on Linux/Windows, a documented-surface change users must be able to look up; the prd-authoring rule requires the docs item.

narrative.Action: PRD §6.7 'Key specs', 'Registration' and 'Required tests' (not the sheet). Dispatch exactly per rules 1–7: one window capture listener for global shortcuts that skips focus inside .xterm; one window bubble listener for not-editing shortcuts (focus not in input/textarea/select/contenteditable/.xterm/.monaco-editor) plus global shortcuts whose focus is inside .xterm; skip defaultPrevented and isComposing in bubble; focus element = event.target if Element else document.activeElement; newest registration first; a match calls preventDefault + stopPropagation then run; when() false or throwing passes the event untouched; chords arm on the first key, expire after 1500 ms, and an unbound second key is consumed by the cancel.
